levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن محمد بن علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «عن أبويهما» is a collective relation to the two co-transmitters in the level above
The Imam named inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «عليهم السلام» is left out
The Prophet is the end of the chain; «آبائه» is the last link, the one whose words the Prophet's saying is relayed through
